COLDWAR_VIE_campaign_apply_guerrilla_lessons = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_VIE_guerrilla_lessons_reward_applied }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				COLDWAR_VIE_campaign_eligible = yes
				custom_trigger_tooltip = {
					tooltip = COLDWAR_VIE_treasury_0_01_tt
					check_variable = { var = treasury value = 0.01 compare = greater_than_or_equals }
				}
			}
			set_temp_variable = { treasury_change = -0.01 }
			modify_treasury_effect = yes
			add_doctrine_cost_reduction = { name = COLDWAR_VIE_guerrilla_lessons category = land_doctrine uses = 1 cost_reduction = 0.15 }
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_VIE_guerrilla_lessons_actions_unlocked
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_VIE_guerrilla_lessons_reward_applied
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_VIE_guerrilla_lessons_pending
		}
		else = { set_country_flag = COLDWAR_VIE_guerrilla_lessons_pending }
	}
}

			NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_VIE_cambodia_intervene_reward_applied }

			limit = {
				COLDWAR_VIE_campaign_eligible = yes
				COLDWAR_VIE_campaign_cbd_hostility = yes
				NOT = { is_in_faction_with = CBD }
				NOT = {
					CBD = { is_subject_of = VIE }
				}
				custom_trigger_tooltip = {
					tooltip = COLDWAR_VIE_treasury_0_04_tt
					check_variable = { var = treasury value = 0.04 compare = greater_than_or_equals }
				}
				OR = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_VIE_cambodia_mandate_reward_applied }
			}
			set_temp_variable = { treasury_change = -0.04 }
			modify_treasury_effect = yes
			create_wargoal = { type = puppet_wargoal_focus target = CBD }
			COLDWAR_VIE_cambodia_intervene_activate = yes
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_VIE_cambodia_intervene_actions_unlocked
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_VIE_cambodia_intervene_reward_applied
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_VIE_cambodia_intervene_pending
		}
		else = { set_country_flag = COLDWAR_VIE_cambodia_intervene_pending }
	}

COLDWAR_VIE_campaign_apply_cambodia_monitor = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_VIE_cambodia_monitor_reward_applied }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				COLDWAR_VIE_campaign_eligible = yes
				has_country_flag = COLDWAR_VIE_campaign_border_commission
				custom_trigger_tooltip = {
					tooltip = COLDWAR_VIE_treasury_0_025_tt
					check_variable = { var = treasury value = 0.025 compare = greater_than_or_equals }
				}
				OR = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_VIE_cambodia_limited_reward_applied }
			}
			set_temp_variable = { treasury_change = -0.025 }
			modify_treasury_effect = yes
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_VIE_cambodia_monitor_actions_unlocked
			COLDWAR_VIE_cambodia_monitor_activate = yes
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_VIE_cambodia_monitor_reward_applied
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_VIE_cambodia_monitor_pending
		}
		else = { set_country_flag = COLDWAR_VIE_cambodia_monitor_pending }
	}
}
COLDWAR_VIE_campaign_apply_cambodia_capital = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_VIE_cambodia_capital_reward_applied }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				COLDWAR_VIE_campaign_eligible = yes
				has_war_with = CBD
				custom_trigger_tooltip = {
					tooltip = COLDWAR_VIE_treasury_0_05_tt
					check_variable = { var = treasury value = 0.05 compare = greater_than_or_equals }
				}
				OR = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_VIE_cambodia_intervene_reward_applied }
			}
			set_temp_variable = { treasury_change = -0.05 }
			modify_treasury_effect = yes
			COLDWAR_VIE_cambodia_capital_activate = yes
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_VIE_cambodia_capital_actions_unlocked
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_VIE_cambodia_capital_reward_applied
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_VIE_cambodia_capital_pending
		}
		else = { set_country_flag = COLDWAR_VIE_cambodia_capital_pending }
	}
}
COLDWAR_VIE_campaign_apply_cambodia_aftermath = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_VIE_cambodia_aftermath_reward_applied }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				COLDWAR_VIE_campaign_eligible = yes
				COLDWAR_VIE_campaign_cbd_victory = yes
				custom_trigger_tooltip = {
					tooltip = COLDWAR_VIE_treasury_0_02_tt
					check_variable = { var = treasury value = 0.02 compare = greater_than_or_equals }
				}
				OR = {
					has_country_flag = COLDWAR_VIE_cambodia_monitor_reward_applied
					has_country_flag = COLDWAR_VIE_cambodia_capital_reward_applied
				}
			}
			set_temp_variable = { treasury_change = -0.02 }
			modify_treasury_effect = yes
			army_experience = 25
			add_doctrine_cost_reduction = { name = COLDWAR_VIE_cambodia_aftermath category = land_doctrine uses = 2 cost_reduction = 0.2 }
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_VIE_cambodia_aftermath_actions_unlocked
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_VIE_cambodia_aftermath_reward_applied
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_VIE_cambodia_aftermath_pending
		}
		else = { set_country_flag = COLDWAR_VIE_cambodia_aftermath_pending }
	}
}

COLDWAR_VIE_campaign_apply_cambodia_talks = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_VIE_cambodia_talks_reward_applied }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				COLDWAR_VIE_campaign_eligible = yes
				OR = {
					COLDWAR_VIE_campaign_cbd_victory = yes
					AND = { COLDWAR_VIE_campaign_limited_settlement = yes has_country_flag = COLDWAR_VIE_campaign_limited_verified }
				}
				custom_trigger_tooltip = {
					tooltip = COLDWAR_VIE_treasury_0_02_tt
					check_variable = { var = treasury value = 0.02 compare = greater_than_or_equals }
				}
				OR = {
					has_country_flag = COLDWAR_VIE_cambodia_restore_reward_applied
					has_country_flag = COLDWAR_VIE_cambodia_verify_reward_applied
					has_country_flag = COLDWAR_VIE_cambodia_limited_commitment_reward_applied
				}
			}
			set_temp_variable = { treasury_change = -0.02 }
			modify_treasury_effect = yes
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_VIE_cambodia_talks_actions_unlocked
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_VIE_cambodia_talks_reward_applied
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_VIE_cambodia_talks_pending
		}
		else = { set_country_flag = COLDWAR_VIE_cambodia_talks_pending }
	}
}
COLDWAR_VIE_campaign_apply_cambodia_limits = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_VIE_cambodia_limits_reward_applied }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				COLDWAR_VIE_campaign_eligible = yes
				OR = {
					COLDWAR_VIE_campaign_cbd_victory = yes
					AND = { COLDWAR_VIE_campaign_limited_settlement = yes has_country_flag = COLDWAR_VIE_campaign_limited_verified }
				}
				has_country_flag = COLDWAR_VIE_campaign_regional_process
				custom_trigger_tooltip = {
					tooltip = COLDWAR_VIE_treasury_0_01_tt
					check_variable = { var = treasury value = 0.01 compare = greater_than_or_equals }
				}
				OR = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_VIE_cambodia_talks_reward_applied }
			}
			set_temp_variable = { treasury_change = -0.01 }
			modify_treasury_effect = yes
			add_doctrine_cost_reduction = { name = COLDWAR_VIE_cambodia_limits category = land_doctrine uses = 1 cost_reduction = 0.1 }
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_VIE_cambodia_limits_actions_unlocked
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_VIE_cambodia_limits_reward_applied
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_VIE_cambodia_limits_pending
		}
		else = { set_country_flag = COLDWAR_VIE_cambodia_limits_pending }
	}
}

COLDWAR_VIE_guerrilla_decision_ceasefire_accept = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			tag = SVN
			has_country_flag = COLDWAR_VIE_guerrilla_decision_ceasefire_inbox
			VIE = {
				COLDWAR_VIE_campaign_eligible = yes
				has_country_flag = COLDWAR_VIE_guerrilla_decision_ceasefire_offer_pending
				COLDWAR_VIE_campaign_eligible = yes
				has_country_flag = COLDWAR_VIE_guerrilla_review_reward_applied
				has_war_with = SVN
				custom_trigger_tooltip = {
					tooltip = COLDWAR_VIE_treasury_0_005_tt
					check_variable = { var = treasury value = 0.005 compare = greater_than_or_equals }
				}
			}
		}
		clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_VIE_guerrilla_decision_ceasefire_inbox
		VIE = {
			set_temp_variable = { treasury_change = -0.005 }
			modify_treasury_effect = yes
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_VIE_guerrilla_decision_ceasefire_offer_pending
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_VIE_guerrilla_decision_ceasefire_awaiting_response
			set_country_flag = { flag = COLDWAR_VIE_guerrilla_decision_ceasefire_accepted days = 180 value = 1 }
			set_country_flag = { flag = COLDWAR_VIE_campaign_southern_terms days = 180 value = 1 }
			add_opinion_modifier = { target = SVN modifier = mdcw_cw_program_partner }
			country_event = { id = COLDWAR_VIE_CAMPAIGN.110 }
		}
		add_opinion_modifier = { target = VIE modifier = mdcw_cw_program_partner }
	}
}

COLDWAR_VIE_guerrilla_decision_ceasefire_send = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			COLDWAR_VIE_campaign_eligible = yes
			has_country_flag = COLDWAR_VIE_guerrilla_review_reward_applied
			has_war_with = SVN
			custom_trigger_tooltip = {
				tooltip = COLDWAR_VIE_treasury_0_005_tt
				check_variable = { var = treasury value = 0.005 compare = greater_than_or_equals }
			}
			SVN = {
				exists = yes
				NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_VIE_guerrilla_decision_ceasefire_inbox }
			}
			NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_VIE_guerrilla_decision_ceasefire_offer_pending }
		}
		set_country_flag = { flag = COLDWAR_VIE_guerrilla_decision_ceasefire_offer_pending days = 90 value = 1 }

COLDWAR_VIE_guerrilla_decision_south_liaison_execute = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			COLDWAR_VIE_campaign_eligible = yes
			has_country_flag = COLDWAR_VIE_guerrilla_cadres_reward_applied
			has_global_flag = mdcw_cw_initialized
			has_government = communism
			check_variable = { ruling_party = 4 }
			SVN = { exists = yes has_country_flag = mdcw_cw_initialized }
			NOT = { has_war_with = SVN }
			has_political_power > 49
			check_variable = { mdcw_cw_cap_free > 0 }
			NOT = {
				check_variable = { mdcw_cw_pps_party@SVN > 0 }
			}
			NOT = {
				check_variable = { mdcw_cw_pps_cd@SVN > global.num_days }
			}
		}
		set_variable = { mdcw_cw_send_party = 4 }
		set_country_flag = mdcw_cw_open
		set_variable = { mdcw_cw_tab = 3 }
		mdcw_cw_refresh_player_view = yes
		mdcw_cw_touch_gui = yes
		custom_effect_tooltip = COLDWAR_VIE_campaign_native_support_tt
	}
}

		}
		country_event = { id = COLDWAR_VIE_CAMPAIGN.109 }
	}

COLDWAR_VIE_china_decision_verify_execute = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			COLDWAR_VIE_campaign_eligible = yes
			has_country_flag = COLDWAR_VIE_china_standdown_reward_applied
			has_country_flag = COLDWAR_VIE_campaign_china_terms
			NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_VIE_campaign_china_drawdown_verified }
			COLDWAR_VIE_campaign_china_standdown = yes
			custom_trigger_tooltip = {
				tooltip = COLDWAR_VIE_treasury_0_015_tt
				check_variable = { var = treasury value = 0.015 compare = greater_than_or_equals }
			}
		}
		set_temp_variable = { treasury_change = -0.015 }
		modify_treasury_effect = yes
		clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_VIE_campaign_frontier_emergency
		set_country_flag = { flag = COLDWAR_VIE_campaign_china_drawdown_verified days = 365 value = 1 }
		COLDWAR_VIE_campaign_daily_update = yes
	}
}
